# Test fixtures

`openapi-3.1-schema-2022-10-07.json` is the OpenAPI Initiative's JSON Schema
for OpenAPI 3.1 documents, unmodified, from
<https://spec.openapis.org/oas/3.1/schema/2022-10-07> (fetched 2026-11-23,
SHA-256 `da01ba28852cac0de53893797cb8d1942bc3b05084f526dcc216717dec314ed0`).
It is part of the OpenAPI Specification, which is published under the Apache
License 2.0. `openapi.test.js` uses it to check that
`docs/schemas/v1/openapi.json` is a valid OpenAPI document.
